injectivity_lemma.statement: if b != b' the values at 0 differ; if b = b' and k != k' the values at 1 differ; hence equality of pairs is equality of maps on the whole of Z

cross_relation.declared_convention_form: chronological word (T_a, D_k) denotes the algebraic composite D_k T_a; chronological word (D_k, T_ka) denotes T_ka D_k
cross_relation.general_argument: star((0,k),(a,1)) = (k*a, k) and star((k*a,1),(0,k)) = (k*a, k) exactly, for every a in Z and every k in N_>0; both sides lower to x -> k*(x+a) = k*x + k*a

dilation_law.general_argument: star((0,k),(0,l)) = (0,k*l) = pair(D_(k*l)) exactly, for every k,l in N_>0

translation_law.general_argument: star((a,1),(b,1)) = (a+b,1) = pair(T_(a+b)) exactly, for every a,b in Z; the sweep calibrates that line
